settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Bastogne December 1944, U.S. 101st Airborne composite soldier POV, snow, fog, pine woods, frozen foxholes, damaged Belgian town streets, period winter uniforms and equipment, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier POV during the defense of Bastogne in the Battle of the Bulge. One action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration and no intelligible human speech. Audio uses breathing, nonverbal exertion, winter wind, snow, footsteps, engines, aircraft, equipment and distant battlefield effects only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person winter warfare reenactment, muted snow colors, fog, cold breath, pine forests, practical 1944 U.S. airborne gear, restrained handheld camera.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP04 — Bastogne: Surrounded in the Snow
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. airborne infantry soldier arrives near Bastogne in December 1944, digs into frozen positions, endures encirclement and shortages, watches the weather finally clear, and ends as a relief corridor opens while the fighting continues.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier during the defense of Bastogne in December 1944. Focus on snow, fog, foxholes, short movements between positions, supply shortages, artillery, weather clearing, aerial resupply and relief. Tell everything visually with no spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Road to Bastogne
scenes.description: POV rides in a truck column toward Bastogne through winter roads.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier grips the truck side as the convoy moves through snow.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. airborne soldier in open truck, winter road, snow-covered fields, period convoy ahead, cold gray sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld POV sways with moving truck. Audio: engine, tires on slush, winter wind, gear rattle, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Town Square
scenes.description: The convoy passes through crowded Bastogne streets.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks from the truck toward soldiers and vehicles moving through town.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person winter Bastogne street, U.S. military vehicles, soldiers moving, stone buildings, civilians only in distant safe areas, no graphic damage.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow pan from convoy ahead to crowded town edge. Audio: engines, boots, distant artillery, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Frozen Ground
scenes.description: The soldier begins digging a defensive position outside town.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands strike frozen soil with an entrenching tool.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands digging frozen earth beside snow-covered pine woods, U.S. airborne sleeves and entrenching tool visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low static POV with repeated digging motion. Audio: metal on frozen ground, wind, distant guns, strained breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Fog on the Line
scenes.description: Heavy fog hides the fields beyond the foxhole.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV peers over a snowy foxhole into dense fog.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over snow-rimmed foxhole toward foggy Belgian field and dark tree line, rifle resting on edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lean upward from foxhole into fog. Audio: cold wind, distant engine rumble, cloth movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Armour in the Mist
scenes.description: Tank silhouettes appear briefly beyond the tree line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier raises binoculars toward dark armored silhouettes.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view through winter fog toward distant German armored silhouettes near tree line, no firing shown.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and hold. Audio: distant engines, wind, binocular handling, faster breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Artillery Snow
scenes.description: An artillery burst throws snow from nearby trees.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops deeper into the foxhole as snow shakes from branches.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person foxhole, snow falling from pine branches after distant shell burst, squadmate crouched nearby, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops once into foxhole. Audio: artillery thump, branches shaking, falling snow, heavy breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Low Ammunition
scenes.description: The squad checks remaining ammunition and supplies.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV opens a small ammunition container and sees limited supplies.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of few ammunition clips and rations inside snowy foxhole, gloves and winter sleeves visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close POV with one box-opening action. Audio: latch click, cartridges, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Night Watch
scenes.description: The soldier keeps watch through a freezing night.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV rubs gloved hands and raises the rifle toward the dark field.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person winter night foxhole, faint moonlight on snow, rifle pointed toward dark field, visible cold breath.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lift from hands to dark field. Audio: cold wind, distant artillery, cloth rubbing, tired breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Bastogne Morning
scenes.description: A gray morning reveals battered roads and continuous traffic inside town.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks one block through town carrying supplies back to the line.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person walk through cold Bastogne street carrying supply box, period jeeps and troops, damaged stone buildings, no bodies.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk through one street. Audio: boots, engines, distant guns, box rattle, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Sky Clears
scenes.description: Clouds finally break and blue sky appears over the snow.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV tilts upward from the foxhole to clearing clouds.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from snowy foxhole toward clearing winter sky over Belgian woods, sunlight breaking through.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow upward tilt to blue opening in clouds. Audio: wind softening, distant aircraft beginning to emerge, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Resupply
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier watches supply parachutes descend beyond the tree line.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person snowy field view with multiple supply parachutes descending in distance under clear winter sky, period aircraft far above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan following one descending parachute. Audio: aircraft engines, wind, parachute fabric, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Fresh Ammunition
scenes.description: The unit receives new ammunition and food.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV hands one ammunition box to the next foxhole.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloves passing ammunition box along snowy defensive line, squadmates in winter gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff motion from POV to adjacent soldier. Audio: box movement, cartridge rattle, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Engines from the South
scenes.description: Distant friendly armored engines are heard approaching.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a snowy road as distant U.S. vehicles approach.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view down snowy Belgian road toward distant U.S. armored silhouettes moving through haze, soldiers watching from roadside.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan toward approaching vehicles. Audio: engine rumble growing, wind, boots in snow, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Corridor Opens
scenes.description: Relief forces reach the Bastogne area and traffic begins moving through a corridor.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches vehicles enter town while keeping the rifle shouldered.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Bastogne road with U.S. vehicles moving into town, snow and damaged buildings, soldier's rifle in foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static roadside POV as vehicles pass. Audio: engines, boots, chains, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Back to the Line
scenes.description: The soldier returns toward the snowy perimeter as the wider battle continues.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV walks back toward foxholes with resupplied gear.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person walk into snow-covered pine defensive line at late afternoon, ammunition and rifle visible, town behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk toward perimeter. Audio: boots on snow, distant guns, equipment movement, tired breathing. End without victory celebration. No speech, no narration.
